sources.title: GitHub - Mekky2/cypher: AI model for identifying and patching ...
sources.snippet: Cypher is a local, AI-powered static application security testing (SAST) tool. It leverages the 32-billion parameter Qwen2.5-Coder model and precise Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing to audit codebases for vulnerabilities without sending your proprietary code to the cloud.

sources.title: Building a multimodal, multi-agent system using Azure AI Agent Service ...
sources.snippet: By the end of this blog you will learn how to build a structured, modular conversational AI system using a multi-agent architecture with Azure AI Agent Service and OpenAI Agent SDK. You'll understand how to set up specialized agents—such as Triage, FAQ, Account Management, and Live Agent—to efficiently handle diverse customer interactions by delegating tasks based on user input.
